VARIABLES pc, x

vars == << pc, x >>

Init == /\ x = 0
        /\ pc = "Start"

Start == /\ pc = "Start"
         /\ IF x < 2
               THEN /\ pc' = "Step"
               ELSE /\ pc' = "Done"
         /\ x' = x

Step == /\ pc = "Step"
        /\ x' = x + 1
        /\ pc' = "Start"

Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == Start \/ Step \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
